about_the_game:
Grow Line Quest is a game that combines dynamic battles, dungeon exploration, and captivating farming. In the game’s world, players dive into exciting adventures, battle enemies, and unlock new development opportunities with each cycle. Each new cycle presents a unique chance to improve your farm, discover rare artifacts, and enhance your character. Develop your farm, fight enemies, and explore the world of Grow Line Quest.

Core Gameplay

In Grow Line Quest, you will explore dungeons, fight enemies, and upgrade your farm. The gameplay includes roguelike elements with procedurally generated levels and encounters with enemies. Each game cycle brings new challenges and opportunities for improvement. The battle mechanics rely on quick reactions and strategic use of gear, making each fight unique.

Farming and Upgrades

One of the central features of the game is farming. Here, players can grow plants, take care of animals, gather resources, and build various upgrades for their farm. These elements are closely tied to dungeon exploration and combat, creating a balance between active and relaxing gameplay.

Dungeon Exploration and Artifacts

Each dungeon in Grow Line Quest is randomly generated, making every game cycle unique. During your explorations, you will find artifacts that help improve your character's skills and unlock new combat and farming opportunities.

Fishing and Fish Collecting

Fishing in Grow Line Quest is an engaging mini-game that allows you to relax and enhance your farm. Catch different species of fish, each with its own unique properties. Collect fish, decorate your farm with aquariums, and use the caught fish to create upgrades.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 (3.4 GHz) / AMD Athlon X4 (2.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 630 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 640 / AMD Radeon HD 7750
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 (3.4 GHz) / AMD Ryzen 3 1300X (3.5 GHz)
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 460
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
